mapper.select: SELECT A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, C.FINPROD_TYPE2 as finprodType2, A.VDATE, A.MDATE, A.PRIN_AMT as prinAmt, A.INT_AMT as intAmt, B.CASH_TYPE_1 as cashType1, C.CCY, C.ISSUE_AMT as issueAmt, C.CHL_FINPROD_ID as chlFinprodId, A.PAY_DATE payDate FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND A.BRANCH = B.BRANCH LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D ON A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND D.BRANCH = #{BRANCH} WHERE A.BRANCH = #{BRANCH} AND (A.PRIN_AMT != 0 OR A.INT_AMT != 0 OR A.CASH_AMT != 0) AND D.TYPE_8 IN (#{PINAN_ASSET_TYPE_ZQ},#{PINAN_ASSET_TYPE_CK},#{PINAN_ASSET_TYPE_JHLLLX},#{PINAN_ASSET_TYPE_XML}) AND B.CASH_TYPE_2 IN (#{CASH_TYPE_2_BJ},#{CASH_TYPE_2_LX}) AND A.MDATE = #{PLATE_DATE}
